readme.markdown:
# Social Perks

**The Marketing Value Protocol** — AI-powered marketing infrastructure for every business.

107 marketing actions across 15 platforms. Pricing oracle for AI agents. Campaign execution layer.

## Quick Start

```bash
npm install
npm run dev
```

Open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000).

## Demo Accounts

## Tech Stack

- Next.js 15 (App Router)
- React 19
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
- Instrument Serif + DM Sans + JetBrains Mono

## Using with Claude Code

This project includes a `CLAUDE.md` file that gives Claude Code full context about the architecture, design system, and what needs building next. Just run:

```bash
claude
```

in the project directory and Claude will understand the full codebase.

toolsPreview.name: getPricing
toolsPreview.description: Get the market-rate pricing for a marketing action. Returns USD value and recommended perk type/value.

toolsPreview.name: listActions
toolsPreview.description: List the 125 marketing actions available on Social Perks. Filterable by platform, type, and effort.

toolsPreview.name: getBenchmarks
toolsPreview.description: Get industry benchmarks (engagement rate, conversion rate, etc.) for a business type.

toolsPreview.name: listCampaigns
toolsPreview.description: List campaigns. Requires auth — returns the caller's campaigns.

toolsPreview.name: searchInfluencers
toolsPreview.description: Search influencers by platform and follower count.

toolsPreview.name: createCampaign
toolsPreview.description: Create and launch a new campaign for the calling business. Returns the campaign id, name, and dashboard URL. The campaign goes live immediately — no separate publish step.

toolsPreview.name: submitProof
toolsPreview.description: Submit proof of completion for a campaign action — a public URL to a post, a screenshot, a video, or platform-verified data. The submission enters a review queue (or auto-approves depending on the campaign's verification mode).

toolsPreview.name: reviewSubmission
toolsPreview.description: Approve or reject a submission. Approving releases the perk; rejecting requires a reason. Use this when the business chooses manual review over auto-verification.

toolsPreview.name: listSubmissions
toolsPreview.description: List submissions for a business or campaign, filterable by state (pending/approved/rejected). Returns paginated results.

toolsPreview.name: getCampaignStats
toolsPreview.description: Get summary stats for a single campaign — total submissions, approved count, conversion rate, perks issued, and time-to-first-submission. Useful for an agent reporting back to its user.
